## Here's what you need to know...
| | |
---
|
### From The Committee to Recall Jamelle McKenzie
---
|
---
| |
---
|
---
This week, the Committee to Recall Jamelle McKenzie took an important step in the recall process by officially filing our response to the councilwoman’s lawsuit challenging the recall effort. We want to ensure that you stay fully informed, which is why we’ve made all documents, evidence, updates, and explanations available on our website: [http://recalljamellemckenzie.com](https://exeprx.clicks.mlsend.com/tj/cl/eyJ2Ijoie1wiYVwiOjEwNTM2NTUsXCJsXCI6MTMzMjg1NDU3Mjg5MDIxMTI4LFwiclwiOjEzMzI4NTQ1Nzk4MjEyOTM5M30iLCJzIjoiZDBmZjM4MWIwZjBkNTBiYyJ9). We encourage you to take a few moments to read through the response, which thoroughly addresses and counters each argument made by Councilwoman McKenzie. One of her claims is that we are merely a group dissatisfied with the outcome of her election; however, it’s worth noting that many of us did vote for her! Our response also provides clear evidence to back up our claims for recall, refuting the baseless accusations she has made against us.
| | |
---
|
### Here are some key highlights from our response:
---
|
---
| |
---
|
---
• **Exhibit E** : A signed affidavit from Shavala Ames, detailing her mistreatment by Councilwoman McKenzie. This includes evidence that McKenzie publicly announced Ames’ firing before she had even been notified. • **Exhibit F** : More evidence supporting the mistreatment claim. • **Exhibit G** : A signed affidavit from Althea Philord-Bradley, describing the toxic work environment fostered by Councilwoman McKenzie, which has contributed to the departure of city employees.
| | |
---
|
### One more thing...
---
|
---
| |
---
|
---
Our response provides a detailed breakdown of how Councilwoman McKenzie blocked constituents, misled the public about key decisions, and improperly participated in BIDA executive session meetings. We invite you to visit [http://recalljamellemckenzie.com](https://exeprx.clicks.mlsend.com/tj/cl/eyJ2Ijoie1wiYVwiOjEwNTM2NTUsXCJsXCI6MTMzMjg1NDU3Mjk0MjY0MDExLFwiclwiOjEzMzI4NTQ1Nzk4MjEyOTM5M30iLCJzIjoiZTIxZGVlY2JmZTJlYzllNiJ9) to read the full response, review the initial lawsuit, and learn more about where the recall process stands. You can also sign up for updates, get involved, and make a donation to support their efforts. Thank you for staying engaged and for your continued commitment to accountability in College Park.
**
United College Park**

DEFEND DEMOCRACY, DEFEND FREEDOM
Your Freedoms Are at Risk—
Take Action Now!
Dear Peter,
Our civil liberties are hanging by a thread, and I need to speak with you about what’s at stake.
These are the fundamental rights guaranteed by the Bill of Rights: freedom of speech, the press, worship, peaceable assembly, the right to bear arms, trial by jury, and protection from government overreach.
[Without these, there is no democracy.](https://www.kennedy24.com/donate-em-cl?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=civil_liberties_9_23_24_una1&n=5)
[Democracy isn’t just about voting – **it’s about being a truly free and empowered citizen.**](https://www.kennedy24.com/donate-em-cl?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=civil_liberties_9_23_24_una1&n=6)
Right now, these freedoms are under assault like never before, and time is running out to take action. I ran for President to restore these essential rights, and **while I’ve suspended my campaign, the fight is far from over.**
Both President Trump and I have felt the crushing force of government censorship, surveillance, and propaganda. We know firsthand what it’s like to face these threats. That’s why I’m continuing this fight alongside him – _but I cannot do it alone_.
[This is no longer just about a campaign for the presidency. It’s about fighting for the issues that matter most – **civil liberties, peace, freedom, and health.**](https://www.kennedy24.com/donate-em-cl?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=civil_liberties_9_23_24_una1&n=7)
Every minute counts. If you care about protecting your freedoms as much as I do, please [**donate right now**](https://www.kennedy24.com/donate-em-cl?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=civil_liberties_9_23_24_una1&n=8). Your support is crucial to keeping this movement alive and defending the rights of every American.
[](https://www.kennedy24.com/donate-em-cl?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=civil_liberties_9_23_24_una1&n=9)
Will you give now to help me keep this fight going? We don’t have time to waste. [Click here](https://www.kennedy24.com/donate-em-cl?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=civil_liberties_9_23_24_una1&n=10) to contribute whatever you can.
Together, we will make sure our civil liberties are defended..

# [Thank this Nebraska state senator for blocking a Republican effort to steal an electoral vote from Kamala Harris](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tf5902155-4a18-4be2-839a-16b13b90b7ab/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)
---
| | [](https://default.salsalabs.org/Td107fa4f-d6d6-4f1f-92be-3aa3e7340946/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)
---
| | | Nebraska Republican Mike McDonnell just did the right thing, blocked an effort to steal an electoral vote from Harris, and may well have kept Trump from the White House. _The Nebraska state senator who Republicans hoped would help ease former President Donald J. Trump's path to the White House by agreeing to change how the state allocates its Electoral College votes said on Monday that he would not do so, ending a brief but intense lobbying effort from allies of Mr. Trump and Vice President Kamala Harris._ _The state legislator, Mike McDonnell, a Democrat turned Republican from Omaha, said that he would not agree to change Nebraska's 32-year tradition of awarding three of the state's five electoral votes by congressional district to a winner-take-all system based on the statewide popular vote, bucking calls from Nebraska's governor and its congressional delegation to help Mr. Trump._ _" I respect the desire of some of my colleagues to have this discussion, and I have taken time to listen carefully to Nebraskans and national leaders on both sides of the issue. After deep consideration, it is clear to me that right now, 43 days from Election Day, is not the moment to make this change."_ _Mr. McDonnell said he had told the state's Republican governor, Jim Pillen, that "I will not change my long-held position and will oppose any attempted changes to our Electoral College system before the 2024 election." (source: [NYT](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tf5cae187-bbe0-4b38-926e-6b017b355218/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9))_ This was the right thing to do, since re-writing the rules to throw a vote to Trump would have been profoundly unfair. And it could have been a game changer, given how close this race is. And it took guts to do it, since he's no doubt catching hell from Trump supporters right now. So let's let him know that real Americans -- who care about fair elections -- appreciate what he has done. [**Add your name, and join us in saying thank you to Nebraska State Senator Mike McDonnell.**](https://default.salsalabs.org/T6c555d65-c619-4d18-8437-80a68d0cdef0/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

subject: 5 reasons (and they’re good reasons, too)
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Andrea Salinas for Oregon
body:
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/93411057/500390853/-1080040549?refcode=email-header&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85Mzg4OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjZjEyM2VjNi1kMDc5LWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRlZTY2ODEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=pZtF0GADyyUoF2Lo0GseULuATWqqAn8WwLKNOZm5Jfw=) Hey – I know that one of the hardest parts about election season is all the campaigns asking you to pitch in and help out. The fact of the matter is, the donations I get from grassroots supporters when I send emails just like this keep the lights on for our campaign. They pay for everything from TV ads to office space — so it’s no exaggeration to say, folks like you are the difference between victory and defeat in this incredibly close race. [_**If that’s all you need to hear, and you’re ready to pitch in and support me, then here’s a link to do just that.**_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/93411058/500390854/1085920126?refcode=email_092324_5-reasons&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85Mzg4OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjZjEyM2VjNi1kMDc5LWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRlZTY2ODEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=pZtF0GADyyUoF2Lo0GseULuATWqqAn8WwLKNOZm5Jfw=) But I also know it’s not an easy choice to donate your hard-earned money, and the burden is on me to prove that it’s worth it. So if you’re looking for a good reason, well, here are five:
1. **I’m fighting for working families because I understand what it’s like when your family does everything right but still can’t get ahead.** My family comes from humble roots. My dad immigrated here from Mexico and worked all kinds of jobs to put food on the table for our family. But even though he and my mom worked as hard as they possibly could, it wasn’t enough to pay for my education — so I paid my own way, pouring cups of coffee and painting fences, and became the first in my family to earn a college degree.

2. **I’m proud to be delivering results for Oregon families.** I’m one of the only representatives to pass legislation in this chaotic, extremist-run Congress. And I’m fighting every day to build an economy that puts working families before corporations — and to protect our fundamental freedoms like the right to choose.

3. **My opponent’s agenda couldn’t be more different.** He wants to ban abortion with no exceptions, cut programs like Medicaid and Social Security that help millions of families, and give tax breaks to millionaires like himself.

4. **Far-right super PACs are targeting this seat because it holds the key to deciding the House.** The NRCC just dumped $6,060,000 into our media market — more than any media market in the entire country. We’ve had to increase our fundraising goals to prepare for an even bigger barrage of attack ads than we were expecting.

5. **Your donation makes a real difference.** Like I said, our grassroots supporters are keeping the lights on. This race is actually a rematch between me and the very same opponent I faced in 2022. I won that race with 50.1% of the vote, so, yes — every dollar really does go a long, long way.

[_**Thanks for taking the time to read this very long email. I don’t know if all five of those reasons will speak to you personally, but if even one of them convinced you, please donate $5 to help us take back the House this November. With your help, we can get this done.**_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/93411059/500390855/1085920126?refcode=email_092324_5-reasons&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85Mzg4OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjZjEyM2VjNi1kMDc5LWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRlZTY2ODEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=pZtF0GADyyUoF2Lo0GseULuATWqqAn8WwLKNOZm5Jfw=) _If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately:_ | | | | [Donate $5 →](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/93411060/500390856/1085920126?refcode=email_092324_5-reasons&express_lane=true&amounts=5,25,50,100,250,500,1000&amount=5&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85Mzg4OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjZjEyM2VjNi1kMDc5LWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRlZTY2ODEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=pZtF0GADyyUoF2Lo0GseULuATWqqAn8WwLKNOZm5Jfw=)

Friends,
Jim Jordan has been peddling a disgusting lie for weeks , and now Ohio is paying the price.
As Chair of the House Judiciary Committee, Jordan spread a baseless conspiracy theory about Haitian immigrants in Ohio capturing and eating pets .

The consequences have been serious. His dangerous lies have led to bomb threats against schools and local government buildings in Springfield, shutting down schools and putting families at risk for an entire week .
This isn’t just reckless – it’s despicable. Jim Jordan is willing to endanger the safety of our communities just to score cheap political points with Donald Trump.
We cannot allow a man like Jordan, who thrives on lies and chaos, to stay in power any longer. Thanks to all of you who've pitched in, our campaign is officially the strongest, best funded and most organized opponent Jim Jordan has ever had to face. But we're falling behind on our $1M goal for September and I need your help to catch up. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tamie-wilson-for-us-c2g?refcode=20240923_ohio_conspiracy_link1]
Jordan has been pushing these racist lies for weeks , fueling fear and chaos while ignoring the real issues facing Ohio.
While Jordan continues to stir up trouble with lies and conspiracy theories, I’m focused on delivering real results for Ohio families – lowering the cost of gas and groceries, making healthcare more affordable, and protecting Social Security.
Jim Jordan has done NOTHING but spread fear and division.
This is straight out of the ULTRA- MAGA playbook – blaming hardworking immigrants and refugees for everything while they distract from their failures.
Jim Jordan and his cronies push these outrageous lies to stoke fear and division, but what they really don’t want you to notice are their reckless economic policies that are destroying the middle class.
They point fingers at vulnerable communities while voting against affordable healthcare, refusing to lower prescription drug prices, and gutting Social Security.
It’s all a smokescreen to hide the fact that they’re not working for you—they’re working for themselves and their billionaire buddies.
This is the most important congressional race in the country , and we cannot afford to let Jordan keep getting away with this.
He’s willing to sacrifice the safety of Americans just to get in the spotlight — and if we don’t stop him, his lies will keep hurting our kids and communities.
Together, we can kick Jim Jordan out of Congress and replace him with a leader who actually cares about all people — not someone who’s putting lives in danger with reckless lies .

| | **For Immediate Release:** September 23, 2024
**Contact:**[press@davemin.com](mailto:press@davemin.com)
**BAUGH BACKS OUT: MAGA Republican Now Refusing To Debate Dave Min**
**IRVINE, CA** — After [originally committing](https://davemin.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1b97cb6a343b55cba640c3404&id=d2bc9bb633&e=7017cc100e) to debate Democratic nominee and State Senator Dave Min in California’s 47th Congressional District, **GOP nominee Scott Baugh is now trying to weasel out of his promise** , stating that his campaign did not think a public dialogue for voters would be “productive.”

With just over 40 days until the November election, CA-47’s Republican nominee Scott Baugh refuses to appear with Dave Min in any debate format. Senator Min has consistently made his willingness to debate Baugh known, and multiple organizations have offered to host such an event. Even with the opportunity to choose the time, place and format, Baugh has made clear that he is afraid to go head to head with Min.

**“I remain eager to debate Scott Baugh at any time, place, and setting,”** said Min. **“But the reality is Scott Baugh won’t debate me because he is talking out of both sides of his mouth, and he’s clearly afraid of being called out on his lies, half-truths, and corruption. While Scott Baugh is too scared to justify why he’s a MAGA extremist or why he supports a federal abortion ban, families in the 47th deserve better. This no-show is disqualifying, and raises the obvious question– what is Baugh trying to hide?”**

This is the latest of many broken promises and outright lies that have come to characterize Scott Baugh’s campaign and his career.
* As a State Assemblymember back in the late 1990s, Baugh developed a reputation for skirting the rules and outright breaking the law, including being indicted for 22 counts (4 felonies) of campaign finance fraud, perjury, and related charges,and overseeing a scheme as Chair of the Orange County GOP to illegally register voters as Republican without their consent.
* In this campaign, Baugh has knowingly mischaracterized Min’s position on Prop 36 – which Min was the first Democratic legislator to support--leading to his being served with a cease-and-desist request, and he has falsely claimed that he did not support a federal abortion ban.

Min has assembled an impressive coalition of support. In addition to being on the DCCC’s Red to Blue List of priority challengers for the House, Senator Min is the consensus choice of Teachers (American Federation of Teachers and the National Education Association), Police (Fraternal Order of Police, Police Officers Research Association of California, and the Association of Orange County Deputy Sheriffs), Firefighters (California Professional Firefighters and the International Association of Firefighters), environmental groups (Sierra Club, League of Conservation Voters, Center for Biological Diversity), women’s rights groups (Planned Parenthood and NARAL), and organized labor (AFL-CIO, SEIU, AFSCME, Teamsters, Carpenters, Building Trades). A full endorsement list is available [here](https://davemin.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1b97cb6a343b55cba640c3404&id=ee24bed85d&e=7017cc100e). ### _California’s 47th is an open Congressional District in Orange County that includes the Cities of Costa Mesa, Huntington Beach, Irvine, Newport Beach, and Seal Beach, and portions of Laguna Beach, Laguna Hills, and Laguna Woods. Incumbent Katie Porter is vacating the seat to run for U.S. Senate. In 2022, Porter defeated former Assemblymember Republican Scott Baugh by 3.44% in this “toss-up” district. State Senator Dave Min currently represents over 80% of Congressional District 47 in Sacramento. In 2020, Min received over 158,000 votes within CA-47, defeating incumbent John Moorlach by 5.15% in this area. 19% of the registered voters in CA-47 are of Asian and Pacific Islander descent, including one of the largest Korean-American populations in the country. _

Hi, it's Rebekah Cummings, Brian's running mate and your candidate for Lt. Governor. **Growing up, libraries and books were where I could find solace from the difficulties of daily life.** I could get lost in the enormity of knowledge and information, learn new viewpoints, read some of the greatest stories ever told, and travel through this world and many others. **_Today marks the start of Banned Book Week, and it's unacceptable that Utah has one of the most restrictive book banning measures in the country._**
We need leaders who will advocate for our children and our communities, not fight educators for more political control. [**With less than 45 days until the election, every dollar raised is important. Can you please chip in what you can to our people-powered campaign today? >>**](https://king4ut.us/l/k57Bo8oBHU7p)
---
| [ ](https://king4ut.us/l/5T7sHNdDRie6)
---
To me, libraries and books are special, and I want others to experience them too. I worked my way up from shelving books at my local library to my current role as Director of Digital Matters at the University of Utah, not because I have a **_"political agenda"_** but because books are my passion. Last legislative session, Brian and I wrote a bill that would protect books from being banned and librarians and educators from **_criminal liability_**. Taking control back from the State and placing it into the hands of local educational leadership. To quote Brian, _“[Legislators] think they know better than parents ... better than educators, better than the children themselves what the children should be reading. That’s a problem in my humble opinion,”_ While I am an educator with a passion for books, I also have three children, and an education system that is not only **_underfunded_** but **_politicized_** and **_heavily censored_** is unacceptable. [**This November, we have the chance to lead Utah toward a future where extremists don't get to dictate what's right and wrong—the people do. Can you please donate to our campaign today and help us spread our message before election day?**](https://king4ut.us/l/BzDzq5ZoJako)

| | | Brian, the fifth of five boys, was born in Salt Lake City.

Returning to Utah after his mission for the LDS church in St. Louis, Missouri, Brian’s decision to follow in his family's legal footsteps unfolded organically. Three out of five brothers became lawyers, and Brian decided to become a trial lawyer representing individuals who have been harmed by insurers’ wrongful denial of claims.

The intertwining of family, career, and public service defines Brian's narrative. As an LDS Bishop in the mid-1990s, he embraced connecting with people during vulnerable moments. Political service became a natural extension of Brian's commitment to community. Elected to the State Legislature in 2008, he later assumed the role of House Minority Leader from 2015 to 2023. In navigating the complexities of legislation, Brian learned the art of thoughtful disagreement for the better—a principle he carried into the legislative sphere from his personal and professional life.

In 2022, Brian's life took a new turn when he married Ann Silverberg Williamson, adding twin daughters and a son to his family. Their Brady Bunch family of seven children, along with three grandkids, gathers for family dinners on Mondays. These visits encapsulate the essence of shared values and a commitment to open dialogue.

Governor. Growing up, libraries and books were where I could find solace from the difficulties of daily life. I could get lost in the enormity of knowledge and information, learn new viewpoints, read some of the greatest stories ever told, and travel through this world and many others. Today marks the start of Banned Book Week, and it's unacceptable that Utah has one of the most restrictive book banning measures in the country. We need leaders who will advocate for our children and our communities, not fight educators for more political control. | To me, libraries and books are special, and I want others to experience them too. I worked my way up from shelving books at my local library to my current role as Director of Digital Matters at the University of Utah, not because I have a "political agenda" but because books are my passion. Last legislative session, Brian and I wrote a bill that would protect books from being banned and librarians and educators from criminal liability. Taking control back from the State and placing it into the hands of local educational leadership. To quote Brian, “[Legislators] think they know better than parents ... better than educators, better than the children themselves what the children should be reading. That’s a problem in my humble opinion,” While I am an educator with a passion for books, I also have three children, and an education system that is not only underfunded but politicized and heavily censored is unacceptable. In service, Rebekah Cummings | We'd hate to see you go, but to unsubscribe from future communications, | | | Brian, the fifth of five boys, was born in Salt Lake City. Returning to Utah after his mission for the LDS church in St. Louis, Missouri, Brian’s decision to follow in his family's legal footsteps unfolded organically. Three out of five brothers became lawyers, and Brian decided to become a trial lawyer representing individuals who have been harmed by insurers’ wrongful denial of claims. The intertwining of family, career, and public service defines Brian's narrative. As an LDS Bishop in the mid-1990s, he embraced connecting with people during vulnerable moments. Political service became a natural extension of Brian's commitment to community. Elected to the State Legislature in 2008, he later assumed the role of House Minority Leader from 2015 to 2023. In navigating the complexities of legislation, Brian learned the art of thoughtful disagreement for the better—a principle he carried into the legislative sphere from his personal and professional life. In 2022, Brian's life took a new turn when he married Ann Silverberg Williamson, adding twin daughters and a son to his family. Their Brady Bunch family of seven children, along with three grandkids, gathers for family dinners on Mondays. These visits encapsulate the essence of shared values and a commitment to open dialogue. Prefer to donate via mail? Address a check to: Brian for Utah P.O. Box 581557 Salt Lake City, UT 84158 | | PAID FOR BY BRIAN FOR UTAH

Hello Friend,

Despite court rulings in Louisiana and Oklahoma that make the teaching of the Bible and the 10 Commandments mandatory in public schools and universities, we still live in a time when the foundational teachings of the Ten Commandments are no longer emphasized in our public schools and daily lives. As a result, our children are growing up without these essential, God-honoring rules for living.

In this culture of moral confusion, the Ten Commandments provide clear, simple answers about what it means to live a righteous life. Teaching these commandments to children not only instills a sense of security and purpose but also fosters emotional resilience, intellectual acuity, and ethical integrity. The Ten Commandments uphold traditional values and celebrate the family unit as foundational to society, helping children navigate life's challenges with confidence and grace.
---
| | That's why I'm excited to introduce my brand new kids book, _The 10 Commandments for Kids_ book. This book offers kids ten Bible lessons about God's simple rules for living, with each chapter explaining one commandment, discussion questions, applications, and prayers to say together. It's a trustworthy resource for children to read on their own, during church services, or as part of vacation Bible school studies.
---
| [](http://links.liberty-pulse.com/u/click?_t=29bc9815846f49728b1d374165de7bf2&_m=3df4d070a43645e9ab3aed9424aab9b4&_e=ntfxlUCidHlR1AtLnNyyd44kPKqJoqAk7ngBCNW9qYMznIM-md-5_h5DpAqZoI5mPijJfzoQtySirHGkteCI4rDljGeguH1jFjuetukITeeVgUKfJzILRsnx3zpkkwJeJDou7fbR_0t2oW9tcFd8_F9QBeiMkU4lRqSODObUKutpfe74ESzaquUNZ65veu_ou5fGNMcrcSNbR_FmBYNqxkfA48gXqhEQUaPQr79tj0BlEK3izVlA5Rp12MrPSkvR7cWisOO0-VhQyBPNG7o3dDPYAO386liaD0ydoFemuoKugBRwHXkBvIv6YSI2bh7TtAniRoTW1hMbDLAKmFdIA_r_lwh0MTapuYsnT57VuYbNXxqNTnjfT0IPLo4GMidH)
---
| | Additionally, for the adults in your life, I've written,_The 10: How to Live and Love in a World That Has Lost Its Way_. This book will refresh your understanding and application of the Ten Commandments, showing how living by these principles can improve our personal lives, relationships, churches, and communities.

**I encourage you to point your children or grandchildren towards Jesus Christ.**

For a gift of any amount to support Pathway to Victory, I will send you both books: [https://secure.ptv.org/the-10-commandments-for-kids-generous-gift-1](http://links.liberty-pulse.com/u/click?_t=29bc9815846f49728b1d374165de7bf2&_m=3df4d070a43645e9ab3aed9424aab9b4&_e=ntfxlUCidHlR1AtLnNyyd44kPKqJoqAk7ngBCNW9qYMznIM-md-5_h5DpAqZoI5mPijJfzoQtySirHGkteCI4rDljGeguH1jFjuetukITeeVgUKfJzILRsnx3zpkkwJeJDou7fbR_0t2oW9tcFd8_F9QBeiMkU4lRqSODObUKutpfe74ESzaquUNZ65veu_ou5fGNMcrcSNbR_FmBYNqxkfA48gXqhEQUaPQr79tj0DDF8T-si4A9fcE7alF_H3eARnVjogaUvUQMWcHK5zWsPvxmMLAgvLYOF5tGHLmvvLZw87TTkQcsrN8WkTdpotj3aoqeL7XOXj-iRjwK9tP6ooL-S-jjNJkc6oMw7AQ4A7xP0CBs0BHual41xVzmNTl)

Your generosity enables _Pathway to Victory_ to share bold biblical truths with a broken world. Together, we will make a difference and bring people closer to Christ.

Thank you for standing with us and sharing the gospel of Jesus Christ.

Sharing the Truth of God's Word,

Dr. Robert Jeffress

Despite vote-suppressing state legislatures making it harder to register to vote -- Passing bills to stop organizations like ours and our partners on the ground from helping potential voters navigate the increasingly murky rules around voter registration -- we're still pulling out all the stops to bring voters into the system.
Voter registration is a critical part of grassroots efforts to protect voting rights. The more people who vote, the more our government looks like we, the people. But to get to the point where every voice is heard we need your help .
Just $3 can help us register a new voter. Will you chip in $24 or more today to help register 8 new voters? >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-voterregistration?refcode=092324_2&amount=24]

Overwhelming key states with new voter registrations can help turn the tide against the voter suppression laws we've seen passed the last few years.
This year's election will determine whether our democracy goes back to the darkness and conspiracy theories of the recent past or if we can reclaim our rights -- from voting to choice and more -- and march forward to a better future.

There is no world where Trump wins by that much and Kari Lake loses.
#

The latest poll from the New York Times has Donald Trump up by four points in Arizona, a complete flip from their previous result:
**PREVIOUS Times/Siena Poll, AUGUST 8-15, 2024:**
_**Trump:**_ 45%
_**Harris:**_ 49%
**NEW Times/Siena Poll, SEPTEMBER 17-21, 2024:**
_**Trump:_** 49% (+4%)
_**Harris:_** 45%
We’ve been doing this a long time, and here’s our two cents: **There is no world where Trump wins by that much and Kari Lake loses.** If his lead is that wide, he will pull Kari Lake over the finish line with him.
And, honestly, that’s the ballgame. Trump will retake the White House and Republicans will retake the Senate. Sorry to put that thought in your head, but it’s true.

**[_Peter, did you see this?! Michelle and Barack Obama just issued a dire warning — and our beloved former first lady said she is terrified about the outcome of this election. | Friends,
Less than 50 days until election day – the time is now! Since I announced my candidacy for State Auditor in January, I have been leading in the polls. Montanans know that as a fourth-generation Montanan I will always put Montana first. During the Covid-19 pandemic, I ran for the Public Service Commission because I knew that Montanans needed strong public servants during one of the most difficult periods in our nation’s history. And, as President of the PSC, I have delivered for Montana’s families. As a small business owner myself, I know how important it is for government to work for the benefit of Montanans and Montana businesses. Government should not be encroaching on every aspect of our lives; rather, government exists to protect our freedoms. And that’s why I am running to be your next State Auditor. I want to protect Montanans from insurance fraud, help prosecute criminals, and fight to protect responsible use of Montana’s natural resources. But, Democrats are chomping at the bit to take control of this important state office. My opponent’s campaign is being funded by the very out-out-state corporations that he used to work for as a corporate executive. They are seeking to bring national liberal policies into this great state. And I am determined to stand in the way of turning Montana into California or Chicago!
---
[CLICK HERE TO DONATE TODAY! ](https://gmail.us22.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e42c6bb78e8b53de5ee6ec610&id=4bd1ae2f40&e=80cd3574a3)
| But, I need you to stand with me. Can you help by contributing to my campaign in the amount of $100, $250 or even the maximum amount of $790?
By chipping in, you will be directly helping our campaign reach thousands of voters at the most crucial time – in the days before the 2024 election. I can lose this election on my own, but I cannot win the Auditor’s race without your financial support. A contribution of $200, $100, or even $50 will help us ‘get on the air’ with radio ads – ads that will help me get the job done for the Treasure State. Thanks for your support and God bless,
James BrownRepublican Nominee for State Auditor P.S. Don’t doubt for a second that out-of-state dark money groups are trying to influence the outcome of Montana’s elections, including this one. We have to win and protect the Montana way of life, but I need your help to do it!

name: Judicial Watch Tipsheet
subject: Judicial Watch: Federal Judge Sets July 20, 2026, Trial Date in Ashli Babbitt $30 Million Wrongful Death Lawsuit
body:
Judicial Watch announced today that, following a hearing on September 20, Judge Ana C. Reyes of the U.S. District Court for the District of Columbia scheduled a trial date of July 20, 2026, for the $30 million wrongful death suit filed on behalf of the estate and the family of Ashli Babbitt, who was shot and killed in the U.S. Capitol on January 6, 2021, by then-Capitol Police Lt. Michael Byrd.

name: Justice Democrats
subject: re: the racist cartoon depicting Rashida Tlaib
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY JUSTICE DEMOCRATS
body:
[1]Justice Democrats

Peter,

Days after the Israeli military killed Lebanese civilians, including a
nine-year-old girl, in a timed attack using explosive devices planted in
pagers, a political cartoonist with the National Review decided to portray
Rep. Rashida Tlaib, the only Palestinian American member of Congress, as a
member of Hezbollah.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/signup/petition_20240923_stand_with_rashida/?source=em20240923-36013&akid=36013%2E1203867%2E9xvhAN ]Tweet from Abraham Aiyash: Shame on the @detroitnews for allowing this
racist, xenophobic vile cartoon on their platform. Pay attention to who
condemns this. And then recognize the different standards Arab and Muslim
politicians are held by.

This is clear anti-Arab bigotry, racism, and Islamophobia — full stop.

As Rashida’s fellow Squad member and Justice Democrats incumbent AOC said,
“The way Islamophobia and anti-Arab hatred is so deeply normalized and
accepted in our politics is horrifying. It rarely receives the equal
condemnation it deserves. It is inexcusable and a massive double standard.
This is disgusting. And so is the silence around it. We see it.”

This is just the latest in a series of ugly personal attacks against
Rashida since last October when she was one of the first members of
Congress to call for a ceasefire in Gaza and the release of all hostages
on both sides. And as Rashida pointed out, this normalized racism within
American media only incites more hate and violence against a community
that is already in so much pain.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/signup/petition_20240923_stand_with_rashida/?source=em20240923-36013&akid=36013%2E1203867%2E9xvhAN ]Let’s show Rashida she isn’t alone in the fight for peace and human
rights for all. Add your name right now to say you stand with Rashida →

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/signup/petition_20240923_stand_with_rashida/?source=em20240923-36013&akid=36013%2E1203867%2E9xvhAN ]Add Your Name

While this shameful and disgusting racism against Arab and Muslim
Americans isn’t new, we must call it out at every turn and ensure Rashida
knows we have her back.

In solidarity,

Justice Democrats

Contribute to Justice Democrats: https://secure.actblue.com/donate/justicedemocrats?refcode=em20240923-36013-footer&t=1002&refcode2=36013_1203867_9xvhAN&akid=36013%2E1203867%2E9xvhAN

This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com. Email is the most important way for us to reach you about opportunities to get involved. If you need to remove yourself from our email list, click here to unsubscribe: https://go.justicedemocrats.com/unsubscribe/unsubscribe/?t=1003&akid=36013%2E1203867%2E9xvhAN

Peter, this is the music of my youth — a turbulent time, but a time that we got through. A time that gives me hope. We got through it and we made a better America.
Now, once again, we have turbulent times. But I'm cautiously optimistic — I think we'll get through it together, as long as we all continue to put our shoulders to the wheel together and do the work. Always remember: positive change is not promised.
And we can all use music as a reminder that optimism is possible and joy can still be ours. So the people I’m listening to now include Kem, Cleo Soul, Jarrod Lawson and Masego. Listen. Enjoy. Fight for the America that can be ours.
Sincerely,
Eric H. Holder, Jr.,

subject: An outrageous attack on democracy

body:
A travesty of justice in Nevada

| | | [ ](jillstein2024.com/)
---
Peter,
With nothing more than a swipe of a pen in a single sentence, The Supreme Court of the United States has allowed the Nevada Supreme Court to deny a real choice to millions of voters in Nevada.

We submitted over 29,000 signatures in Nevada, almost three times the required threshold for ballot access. Hard working petitioners braved the sweltering heat to collect signatures of voters who want more democratic choices on the ballot. But after all this hard work, in swooped the anti-Democratic Party with one of their many lawsuits to kick us off the ballot. Some media outlets are simply saying “the Green Party used the wrong paperwork.” But here’s the real story: we submitted the correct petition form to the Nevada Secretary of State (a Democrat), they instructed us to use the wrong form, and then the Democrats sued us for using that form! As our legal brief to the Supreme Court said, this violates our constitutional rights by allowing _“the government to tell someone to stand on a carpet and then pull that carpet out from under them.”_ The Stein/Ware campaign has been besieged by lawfare and dirty tricks by the anti-Democratic Party because we’re challenging empire with the only anti-genocide, pro-worker, climate emergency campaign that will be a choice for voters all over the nation. We’ve been able to beat back their attacks on democracy in Wisconsin, Georgia, and most recently New Hampshire. Because of supporters like you, we’ve not only survived, but we continue to thrive. Now we need your support to get the word out to the over 90% of voters who will have Jill and Butch on the ballot that they don’t have to vote for the duopoly candidates of war and Wall Street, and make sure that they know they can vote their values this November.
---

---
We are just $4,000 short of our goal for creating an ad to get our message out to people across the country. A majority of voters will have an anti-genocide, pro-worker, climate emergency administration as an option in November, but many still don’t know about Jill and Butch. An ad will help us get the word out.

[_**Peter, if everyone who gets this email can pitch in, we will more than make our goal and be on our way to paying to promote the ad:**_](https://www.jillstein2024.com/ads?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=1_fund_pm_9_23&n=2)

---
Without a write-in option, we encourage our Nevada supporters to vote “None Of The Above” to register their support of Jill and Butch’s campaign for people, planet and peace and defy this travesty of justice. But we won’t stop fighting just because the anti-Democratic Party succeeded in disenfranchising voters in one state. Instead, we’re asking everyone to double down on voting Green to build the movement for real democracy. Thank you for everything you do to build the fight for people, planet, and peace and turn the White House into a Green House! In solidarity and gratitude, Team Jill Stein & Butch Ware 2024

name: Rob Mercuri
subject: Gaining Momentum as Early Mail Voting Begins Next Week
body:
With less than 45 days left until Election Day, our campaign’s momentum is continuing to trend upward.

|
---
Friend, With less than 50 days left until Election Day, our campaign’s momentum is continuing to trend upward - a strong grassroots team is hitting doors and making phone calls, direct mail is landing in mailboxes, and our ads are on the airwaves! We are coming off an incredible weekend with the Young Republicans, who helped us knock on over 4,600 doors across the district - people at the doors and throughout PA-17 agree, it is time to do better & bring leadership back to Washington! Our first television spot, which began last month, showcased our message advocating for unity and common sense in Washington. As your Congressman, I will work to bring down the temperature, while returning balance and tenor to the conversation in our nation’s capital - you can check it out here: [](https://robmercuri.nationbuilder.com/r?u=QfIZV-WGX1tv8x-Rj8_8rmPIALQoB_HtQ9yBvm3EsddjZJ27kvKOVEVPPTiC7aR5&e=3e5e734082f1493d27255edb80fe3a63&utm_source=robmercuri&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=09_20_24_email_blast_to_suppor&n=1) While getting our message to the voters is important, we know that the act of voting itself will determine who wins. It is vitally important that we encourage our family, friends, and neighbors to vote by mail this election year - as ballots begin to reach the mailboxes starting next week, we need to ensure that those around us are aware of the benefits of voting early and doing so by mail. Please visit this link, which provides important information regarding the process of banking your vote early in Pennsylvania - [https://www.pa.gov/en/agencies/vote/voter-support/mail-in-and-absentee-ballot.html](https://robmercuri.nationbuilder.com/r?u=lvC0zySgANn09obiz0UGcERadoCJMnx4lvjd6hWYm23JJIaJVq4OiF7UA8BAGDB6hkHTIN7hHJuZw7gKG8dpLZfHE6IeSMQloGoFzyqHMSr-6YeNgLKe-Bqs-QQZ6msG&e=3e5e734082f1493d27255edb80fe3a63&utm_source=robmercuri&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=09_20_24_email_blast_to_suppor&n=2) With early voting around the corner and our message reaching new audiences every day - now is the time for you to [join us in the final sprint!](https://www.robmercuri.com/volunteer?e=3e5e734082f1493d27255edb80fe3a63&utm_source=robmercuri&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=09_20_24_email_blast_to_suppor&n=3) Whether it be for door knocking, phone banking, or sign waving, we welcome you to join us. Your participation will help us flip this seat and deliver common sense leadership in Washington. Of course, all of these things take financial resources. Any contribution is greatly appreciated. Can you [give $25, $50, or $100](https://robmercuri.nationbuilder.com/r?u=flBDtqPbDiWRlxBXWwXH-QmKshK3no_4UipNukJhZ99RDhsiM_AR4u1oRxwyteWjGKMDFyYj98-cMSyXV0pVxw&e=3e5e734082f1493d27255edb80fe3a63&utm_source=robmercuri&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=09_20_24_email_blast_to_suppor&n=4) to help us stay on the airwaves? One hundred percent of the money raised between now and the end of September will go straight to voter outreach. Can you [make a difference today?](https://robmercuri.nationbuilder.com/r?u=flBDtqPbDiWRlxBXWwXH-QmKshK3no_4UipNukJhZ99RDhsiM_AR4u1oRxwyteWjGKMDFyYj98-cMSyXV0pVxw&e=3e5e734082f1493d27255edb80fe3a63&utm_source=robmercuri&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=09_20_24_email_blast_to_suppor&n=5) I am grateful for your continued support, and I look forward to winning with you this November! Voting YES on Question 1 will ensure that every Marylander has reproductive freedom and the power to make their own healthcare decisions, including access to abortion. clean_body: This is a critical moment for our campaign Peter, I stood with Trump in Butler. I joined him again in Harrisburg. I was by his side in Wilkes-Barre. We rallied supporters in Johnstown. And today, I'm proud to join him again for another rally in Indiana County. But before I take the stage with President Trump, I have an important request. So I've set a goal of gathering 5,000 donations before the rally is over. This goal is so important because voting has already begun in Pennsylvania. We can't afford to waste any more time while undecided voters are making up their minds about who to cast their ballot for. Next week, we will also close the books on the 3rd quarter. It will be the final quarterly FEC fundraising report we file before Election Day. Everything we raise before this critical deadline will be instrumental in funding the final stretch of the campaign. If you can only give a few dollars, it 'll go a long way. But if you can give even more, say $100, or even $500 or more, the impact it'll make on my campaign will be insurmountable. name: Lucas Kunce
subject: An update about my campaign
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Lucas Kunce for Missouri
body:
#
Hi Peter, it’s Lucas Kunce with an important update.
**Our last end-of-quarter FEC fundraising deadline is exactly one week away.** After September 30th, we’ll submit our last quarterly fundraising report to the Federal Election Commission — giving everyone, including Josh Hawley and the DC insiders set to spend millions of dollars propping him up, an inside look at our grassroots campaign.
**This deadline is one of our last real chances before Election Day to prove that our people-powered movement to take back Missouri’s U.S. Senate seat is strong and ready to win on November 5th.**
So before I ask you to [**chip in $10 or just whatever you can toward our most ambitious end-of-quarter fundraising goal yet**](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/72844?refcode=em20240923-7775&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=7775%2E614464%2EGZtzoT) — **$5 million raised online before September 30** — please let me share more about why this goal matters.**
**[CHIP IN NOW →](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/72844?refcode=em20240923-7775&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&akid=7775%2E614464%2EGZtzoT)**
**Before I explain anything else, I want you to know that this isn’t some arbitrary goal.** All of the goals our campaign emails you about are based in reality and, so far, grassroots supporters like you have helped us reach them at each critical benchmark.
But now that we are less than 45 days from Election Day, we need more support than ever to fight back against the false attack ads flooding the airwaves across Missouri, reach undecided voters, and give this race everything we’ve got in this final stretch.
That’s why my team and I are going to do everything we can this week to hit this goal — **including asking grassroots supporters like you to chip in $10, $15, or whatever you think is best before Monday’s deadline.[Can I count on you to chip in today, Peter?**](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/72844?refcode=em20240923-7775&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=3&akid=7775%2E614464%2EGZtzoT)
If you've stored your info with ActBlue Express, we'll process your contribution instantly:
[Contribute $10](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/72845?refcode=em20240923-7775&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=10&t=4&akid=7775%2E614464%2EGZtzoT) [Contribute $25](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/72845?refcode=em20240923-7775&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=25&t=5&akid=7775%2E614464%2EGZtzoT) [Give another amount](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/72844?refcode=em20240923-7775&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=6&akid=7775%2E614464%2EGZtzoT)
---
From the moment I got into this race, Josh Hawley and the DC insiders propping up his campaign have been determined to tear me down. That’s because, with help from grassroots supporters like you — chipping in and sharing our message when you can — we’ve made it clear: **our campaign is a real threat to their grip on Missouri’s U.S. Senate seat.**
We’ve broken Missouri fundraising records quarter after quarter and built a truly people-powered coalition to take back this Senate seat, earning support from Reproductive Freedom For All, Missouri AFL-CIO, the Missouri Fire Fighters, Missouri Laborers, and so many more organizations fighting for our rights. **Now, multiple new polls show that I’ve cut Josh Hawley’s double-digit lead in HALF over the last month!**
That’s why Hawley’s billionaire-funded Super PAC has already spent over $1 MILLION to attack me on TV — and it’s why DC insiders are transferring as much money as they can into Hawley’s campaign each quarter.
They know that Hawley is the most vulnerable GOP senator up for re-election this year. And they can tell we’ve built a powerful grassroots movement that’s capable of winning this race, flipping this U.S. Senate seat, and taking back power for real working people.
**So now, we have to put the pedal to the metal in the final stretch of this campaign** — and that’s why I’m asking for your help today, Peter. [**Can I count on you to add a donation of $10, $15, or whatever you think is best today so we can hit our most ambitious end-of-quarter goal yet, defeat Josh Hawley, and send a real warrior for working people to represent Missouri in the U.S. Senate? I’m not taking a cent from corporate PACs or shady mega-donors in this race, so I mean it when I say anything you can give really makes a big impact.**](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/72844?refcode=em20240923-7775&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=7&akid=7775%2E614464%2EGZtzoT)
If you've stored your info with ActBlue Express, we'll process your contribution instantly:
[Contribute $10](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/72845?refcode=em20240923-7775&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=10&t=8&akid=7775%2E614464%2EGZtzoT) [Contribute $25](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/72845?refcode=em20240923-7775&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=25&t=9&akid=7775%2E614464%2EGZtzoT) [Contribute $30](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/72845?refcode=em20240923-7775&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=30&t=10&akid=7775%2E614464%2EGZtzoT) [Contribute $50](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/72845?refcode=em20240923-7775&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=50&t=11&akid=7775%2E614464%2EGZtzoT) [Contribute $100](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/72845?refcode=em20240923-7775&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=100&t=12&akid=7775%2E614464%2EGZtzoT) [Contribute $250](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/72845?refcode=em20240923-7775&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=250&t=13&akid=7775%2E614464%2EGZtzoT) [Give another amount](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/72844?refcode=em20240923-7775&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=14&akid=7775%2E614464%2EGZtzoT)
---
**When we defeat Josh Hawley and flip this seat, I promise you this: We’re going to shake things up in the U.S. Senate.**
Together, we’ll secure voting rights, outlaw war profiteering, abolish corporate PACs, empower workers, and stand up to Big-Brother-style attacks on abortion and reproductive rights from control-obsessed politicians like Josh Hawley.
We’ll stop handing out money for Wall Street and forever wars, and start rebuilding communities in Missouri and all across the country. And we’ll create the next generation of energy jobs right here at home.
That’s what we’re fighting for in this movement. And I’m glad you’re a part of it.
Now let’s reach this goal together,
Lucas Kunce

**[Donate](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lk-email-footer?refcode=em20240923-7775-footer&t=15&refcode2=7775_614464_GZtzoT&akid=7775%2E614464%2EGZtzoT)**

body:
The path is challenging, but we won’t stop fighting

|
---

| | [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/93420620/500423022/1523180428?refcode=MW_ATA_EM_FR_News_240923_T1_1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODY1NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJmMGQ5NmU0OS1lNjc5LWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRlZTY2ODEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=4Hs4J9xOOfI20BJT7YEA5l2U6-ZnQ_-tmxC6ri79U8w=) Derek,

I want to make sure you saw this headline from a recent Newsweek article: **Democrats’ Chances of Beating GOP for Senate Control Get Worse** I’m not going to sugarcoat this – our Senate majority is at risk. We have our work cut out for us if we’re going to keep the Senate blue. And there’s no time to waste with fewer than seven weeks until Election Day, and early voting beginning in many states (like Virginia!) well before then.

**[_Rush $10 today to help me support battleground Democrats and protect our Senate majority >>>_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/93420621/500423024/1523180428?amount=10&refcode=MW_ATA_EM_FR_News_240923_T1_1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODY1NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJmMGQ5NmU0OS1lNjc5LWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRlZTY2ODEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=4Hs4J9xOOfI20BJT7YEA5l2U6-ZnQ_-tmxC6ri79U8w=)**

Democrats entered the 2024 election with a one-seat majority. It doesn’t get any closer than that. We have very little margin for error.

| **Meet Kevin Lincoln
**
My name is Kevin Lincoln, and my story, is the Valley’s story. I am a 3rd generation Stocktonian, raising a 4th generation in the city I love. I’m the grandson of Mexican immigrants, and my stepfather is an Army veteran.

Like many Stocktonians, my family has overcome economic setbacks. My own father struggled to survive on these streets, and was at one time, homeless. But I never let adversity define me. I joined the Marines and served in the White House Military Office, assigned to Marine One. I graduated college while working full-time and raising a family. This puts our razor-thin House Majority in jeopardy, so we need to hone in on top races where we have a chance to flip a seat – races like Kevin Lincoln’s in CA-9. As a Marine Corps veteran, former pastor, and current Republican Mayor of one of California’s larger cities, Kevin is not only the kind of leader we need in Congress, but he also knows how to win. With just weeks until every voter in Kevin’s district receives their ballot in the mail, This seat is a critical part of our 2024 strategy to protect the House, and I won’t accept losing just because we didn’t gather the resources needed to win. Thank you! Steve Scalise | Meet Kevin Lincoln My name is Kevin Lincoln, and my story, is the Valley’s story. I am a 3rd generation Stocktonian, raising a 4th generation in the city I love. I’m the grandson of Mexican immigrants, and my stepfather is an Army veteran. Like many Stocktonians, my family has overcome economic setbacks. My own father struggled to survive on these streets, and was at one time, homeless. But I never let adversity define me. I joined the Marines and served in the White House Military Office, assigned to Marine One. I graduated college while working full-time and raising a family. I’ve worked in corporate America and served our community as a pastor, and as a non-profit leader. I’m blessed with a beautiful wife, Bonnie, and two amazing children. For years, VoteVets has run ads. Television ads, digital ads, radio ads. Millions and millions of dollars worth. You name it, we’ve run it.

Friend,

Something exciting is happening out West that I need you to know about.

In the presumed safe-blue state of New Mexico, Republican nominee for U.S. Senate **Nella Domenici** has the Democrats on their heels.

Polling has her within single digits of a 15-year career left-wing politician, _with 21% of voters undecided!_

Nella outraised Heinrich in her first quarter, and she’s unexpectedly put New Mexico in play as a seat Republicans could flip.

[**Now, I’m calling on the grassroots to mobilize around Nella’s campaign and continue providing an influx of support to her campaign so she doesn’t lose this momentum.**](http://links.g4yamerica.com/u/click?_t=cc7dda5c2cc64061900678c88bd3a18a&_m=a1e1b8ddf264402d83cbb49038a170cb&_e=MOr5cMSl7a0zh3xucHxnNCSw5Ceq52uFfn9cbW4boVFvU_zrM8tbWIkoHGIVVIalkjUCoN-G0DqPKoZW06AZ_O1F33DnyV59qlZHG6XupKnpWhznoKW21SGuv-EkdL_8miUW_awf_PV9DRg93_WUj8k-sdUdSve2a9p0l17xgMKX442p8J-4qDN0iM50y-lHX0NYbbeGu-MztQhhrmDHgMgPfZ-qaqPmhACRDvS9PeL1P_bEHCJmkA-tlJksPaEvYNeZ6Gl3M0_fmlDYGEM2-trSd5D-ndDaP8Mshs932xjwv-EY8CeSBtPKpS8G1SuuW8aIxcVON_oj7WGdtiNeim-6s3crRmohaB6v7TognasTzPh55BaVgY-Qqj7AYJa7oVaFgo9yFCoxSTy_9UPxww%3D%3D)

It’s exciting to think I could have another Republican woman from the West joining me in the Senate. But most importantly, she’ll be joining us as a new vote on critical fights to secure our borders, restore economic stability, promote domestic energy production and independence, and ensure safer communities.

Nella Domenici has my full support, and she’s on the brink of taking the lead in a race Democrats never thought they would have to fight.

For America,

Cynthia Lummis

[ ** STEP IT UP FOR NELLA » **](http://links.g4yamerica.com/u/click?_t=cc7dda5c2cc64061900678c88bd3a18a&_m=a1e1b8ddf264402d83cbb49038a170cb&_e=MOr5cMSl7a0zh3xucHxnNCSw5Ceq52uFfn9cbW4boVFvU_zrM8tbWIkoHGIVVIalkjUCoN-G0DqPKoZW06AZ_O1F33DnyV59qlZHG6XupKnpWhznoKW21SGuv-EkdL_8miUW_awf_PV9DRg93_WUj8k-sdUdSve2a9p0l17xgMKX442p8J-4qDN0iM50y-lHX0NYbbeGu-MztQhhrmDHgMgPfZ-qaqPmhACRDvS9PeL1P_bEHCJmkA-tlJksPaEvAFY8Fvcd9_ExTEDFBIblaAIkmRmW9mRw9Km93AgZfHxpy-KgP3JG6IB0KGADa5s6bb9lMlVbE7Kp0vvPVogQKuJ8Gyg-QuLlEVhjUKNuCaRz6l_5n3CCX6BRA8kqStoLJZHQvSzGmnTH4iaTMVvYZg%3D%3D)

| **ABOUT NELLA**
**New Mexico is Nella Domenici’s home. She was born in Albuquerque and lived for most of her childhood in a home near the intersection of Lomas and Monroe with her seven siblings, and her parents - Pete and Nancy Domenici. Nella began her education at Our Lady of Fatima, where she learned the values she holds today. Nella is a proud third-generation New Mexican, devoted mother of two, step-mom of four, and the wife of a Navy Veteran. Nella’s family’s roots run deep in New Mexico and she and her husband Pat enjoy their family home in New Mexico that they have owned for nearly twenty years.

Like most New Mexicans, Nella Domenici understands the importance of hard work. She waited tables to help pay for her undergraduate degree from Georgetown University, and worked her way through night school at Georgetown Law while holding down a full time job. She then graduated from Harvard Business School as a Baker Scholar, top 5% of the class, while 9 months pregnant.

Nella began her career at the bottom and worked her way up through the complex finance world, eventually serving as CFO for one of the world’s largest, most successful investment firms. In her career, Nella advised, invested in, grew, and led many companies, and served on public company boards. The industries she has worked in are vast and include areas such as health care, AI, food service, lodging, commercial real estate, mortgage lending, and consumer products. These companies have ranged from small family-owned businesses, to rapidly growing venture backed enterprises, to a Fortune 200 company. Several of these have been headquartered in New Mexico. Collectively, the companies Nella has been heavily involved with have employed thousands of Americans.

Like her father and mother, Nella has been a warrior for those who most need an advocate: for women competing in academics or business, for families dealing with mental illness, and for those without access to quality healthcare or education. **

Hansjörg Wyss, through his Berger Action Fund, has donated $243 million to the Sixteen Thirty Fund, which “uses its war chest ... to support massive get-out-the-vote drives, issue advocacy campaigns bolstering President Biden’s agenda, liberal pet projects from abortion to immigration, and attack ads against Republican lawmakers,”

Swiss billionaire Hansjörg Wyss has been channeling substantial funds into American state ballot initiatives through the 1630 Fund aka Sixteen Thirty Fund, a progressive advocacy group.As reported by Americans for Public Trust, Wyss’s donations, which total around $243 million to the group, have been instrumental in influencing policies across various states, with a significant focus on Michigan. Since 2017, nearly $34 million has been funneled into Michigan to, among other goals, "rewrite the state’s election laws." This massive infusion of cash aims at bolstering liberal causes from immigration to abortion and enhancing Democratic voter turnout. Such activities have sparked controversy and legislative responses aimed at curbing foreign influence in American electoral processes.https://thefederalist.com/2024/04/18/dark-money-group-backed-by-foreign-billionaire-has-dumped-100-million-into-state-ballot-initiatives/1630 Fund is currently funding multiple ballot initiatives in Alaska, including Alaskans For Better Elections AKBE who brought Ranked Choice Voting to Alaska. Also including the recent push for a higher minimum wage. At some point, one must question when the regulators and government officials, elected to safeguard citizens, become tools manipulated by these malicious actors to act against the citizens they are meant to protect.(e.g. we have been attacked 4 times so far 3 times using state offices, we have been spied on, harassed, and our reputations damaged nationwide all because we were trying to address an election system we didn't feel was a good fit for Alaska)I hope you take this threat to your State Seriously, they are incredibly well funded and they are hell bent on making changes to the State of Alaska. This is one of those cases of too big to fail, where you will attack Alaskans and regular people, but applying these rules to a Swiss Billionaire is outside your job and expectations. As a citizen it saddens me to learn that millionaires and billionaires have more influence on a state and the way the state operates than the people who live here.Phil IzonPer State Statutes:**Sec. 15.13.068. Derek, the only way we can stop all of this from happening is by electing Kamala Harris, Tim Walz, and Democrats up and down the ballot on Election Day. But we can’t do that without your help. In front of a crowd in Wisconsin, he talked about the violent aftermath of his plan to carry out mass deportations, and this wasn’t the first time his extreme immigration plan would target millions of people, tearing families apart and creating chaos for everyone in our communities, immigrant or not. This isn’t just hateful rhetoric, Peter — it’s a blueprint for ethnic cleansing. These proposed policies are dangerous and dehumanizing, set a dangerous precedent in making it okay to violate our human rights, and incite fear and violence. We’ve seen it in places like Springfield, Ohio, where schools are receiving bomb threats following Trump’s baseless claims about Haitian immigrants.
We’ve already seen what Trump’s hate and lies can do. He’s demonized immigrants and people of color. If he wins in November, we will see a terrifying escalation of cruelty, with devastating consequences for families across the nation.
**But here’s the thing: We have the power to stop him.** We have less than 50 days to fight back and mobilize millions of voters to the polls. These next few weeks are critical to ensuring that Trump’s hateful vision for America doesn’t become our reality again.

name: LinebergerforUSCongress
subject: Update from Lineberger for US Congress – September 23rd, 2024
body:
Hi Friends of Lineberger for US Congress!

*We are so Engaged*. I hope you are too. We are down to within the last
44 days until the election is complete.
October 7th is the last day to register and be able to vote in this
election.
*Double check on VoteTexas.gov! or VoteDenton.gov!*
October 21st marks the start of early voting. November 5th is election
day!
*Make sure you and your circle have your plan to vote!*

*Here** are special events to support and interact with our community*.

*CCA (Christian Community Action)* does a lot of good work in the community
with food pantry, job training, counseling and more. They are having
a *fundraising
5K on Saturday, September 28th, in Old Town Lewisville*. We are planning
to support by showing up as a team to run (or to support) in our
‘Lineberger’ T-shirts (or other light blue shirt).
Our special Team 5k Sign up link is:
*https://runsignup.com/Race/TX/Lewisville/hearts?raceRefCode=FcG0YSnd*
<https://runsignup.com/Race/TX/Lewisville/hearts?raceRefCode=FcG0YSnd>
This includes a price break and admission to City
of Lewisville Western Days
The mobilize link is:
https://www.mobilize.us/dentondemocrats/event/675364/
(just for RSVP, use the first link to sign up/pay
for the event)

*Other Help needed*:

We still have a few more of the new signs – exactly twice the size of a
standard yard sign (36 x 24).
OK, they are small. Especially compared to the large 4’ x 6’
road signs from our opponent.
but they are easier to install and will give us
some presence at a reduced cost.
I like that they aren’t as ‘in your face’ as the
others. More like a whisper than a scream.
Huge thanks to our sign team that is working the logistics of road and
polling station signs.
Denton County has 54 early voting sites listed on votedenton.gov,
plus more in Cooke and Wise Counties.
Please consider being a sign volunteer in your area to help
place signs for early voting.
- This is a pretty low time commitment with a
strong benefit.
*Use this link to volunteer* to place signs at one or more polling locations
Sign Volunteers: Lineberger for US Congress - Polling Location Sign
Placement and Pickup (signupgenius.com)
<https://www.signupgenius.com/go/10C0B4BAAAD2FA1FACF8-51480094-lineberger#/>

*We have been ramping up our campaign in multimedia formats*.
- Digital Ads are playing targeting in-district voters viewing streaming
television and other social media
- We have print ads and campaign questionnaire answers in ‘The Cross
Timbers Gazette’
- We have been sending a few targeted direct texts to folks in our
district near some of our events
Even if they don’t come to the event, they will have seen my
name.
- We added content to our Tik Tok and YouTube accounts to help reach voters
- Tik Tok has over 1700 followers, 4900 likes
(@ernestlineberger)
- YouTube; (@LinebergerforUSCongress)
- In addition to ongoing Facebook, Instagram and X accounts, plus the
website.
We were awarded the endorsement from The Alliance for Retired Americans!
This in addition to our endorsement from the Texas AFL-CIO
union!
In October, I’ll have interviews with the Star-Telegram and the
Dallas Morning News
These are joint interviews with my opponent. They
may or may not result in a recommendation.

*All of this to try to reach our 300,000 vote win number.*
Hopefully, after seeing my name in a few places, more people will reach
out to you and us for those healthy, convincing conversations that reassure
people that we are for real. *When that opportunity comes your way, make
it count*!

That said, I want to give a huge shout out to all of you who are already
working it! Thank you!
*Block Walkers* – We continue to have our Saturday morning
block walks except this weekend (CCA 5K, etc.).
Plus, several volunteers have asked for turf maps
to knock doors on their own schedule!
*Phone Bankers* – Our trained crew is working it on their own
schedule. Let us know if you want to join.
This is a great way to connect voters with our
message from the comfort of your home.
*Postcards* – We bought 10,000 and have handed out over 8,500
to be addressed and mailed so far.
Thank you so much for all you are doing to help in these
efforts!

With that in mind, here is what’s coming up soon, plus major events up to
the election.

*Friday, Sept 27th*, Old Town Lewisville Western Days, sharing our message
from Flower Mound Area Democrats Booth
Starting at 4 pm

*Saturday, Sept 28th*, CCA 5K in Old Town Lewisville (see earlier paragraph
for details and links)

*Saturday, Sept 28th*, 6 pm, Hope in Harmony – unity and love concert,
Creekview High School, 3201 Old Denton Rd.
www.mmconservatory.org

*Sunday, Sept 29th*, Northaven UMC for morning worship and a message from
Jim Wallis, author “False White Gospel”

*Tuesday, Oct 1st*, 7:30 pm, VP Debate Watch Party, Brass Tap, Highland
Village

*Thursday, Oct 3rd*, 6:30 pm, Robson Ranch monthly meeting, Ernest to speak

*Thursday, Oct 3rd*, 6 pm, LISD Candidate Forum, Lewisville High School
-My understanding is that I will provide my answers on video.

*Saturday, Oct 5th*, 9 am – noon, Block Walk, TBD

*Saturday, Oct 5th*, 5 – 10 pm, Denton County Indian Cultural Association,
DANDIYA Night, McKamy Middle School

*Sunday, Oct 6th*, 2 – 5 pm, Lantana Area Dem’s Election Kickoff,
Bartonville

*Friday, Oct 11th*, 10 – 11 am (event goes longer), Daily Bread Open House,
909 N Loop 288, Denton

*Saturday, Oct 12th*, 10 am – 5 pm, Cooke County Depot Days

*Sunday, Oct 13th*, 2 pm, Dems of 380 candidate event

*Tuesday, Oct 15th*, 5:30 – 8:30 pm, Prestonwood Candidate Forum and Mixer,
6801 W Park Blvd, Plano

*Monday, Oct 21st*, 7 am, Early Voting Begins!!! - Poll Greeting daily
(Will need lots of help to staff the major polling sites)

*Friday, Nov 1st*, 7 pm, Early Voting Ends

*Saturday, Nov 2nd*, 11 am, Denton Women’s March – followed by block
walking TBD

*Tuesday, Nov 5th*, 7 am – 7 pm, Election Day – Poll Greeting (Will need
even more help with even more polling sites)

*Tuesday, Nov 5th*, Election Night Watch Party, Union Bear Brewing Company,
215 S Bell Ave, Denton

To donate, just go to the regular donation link on the campaign website,
https://www.linebergerforuscongress.com/.

Everything you do to support us in our efforts to get our message out,
support our campaign financially, and your own personal efforts to share
our message are making a difference. Thank you!

Giving Voters a Better Choice and Hope for a Better Future!

Ernest Lineberger

Your Democratic Nominee for US House for TX CD26.

Folks, I want to get real with you for a minute: The term “extreme” gets thrown around a lot in politics these days, and I think we owe it to each other to be really clear about what we mean when we say this.
A basic definition of extreme is very severe, beyond the “usual,” or drastic.
So it is absolutely not an exaggeration to say that far too many of today’s Republican politicians – certainly including my opponent – are extreme .
I want to be clear about this: “Extreme” doesn’t just mean something or someone I disagree with. Working with people who you don’t agree with on every issue is a baseline job requirement in Congress, and one I’m proud to have leaned into over my first two terms!
But...
Wanting to ban abortion nationwide when a broad majority of Americans believe abortion should be legal? Extreme.
Saying climate change is a hoax when an overwhelming majority of scientists agree that not only is it real, its primary cause is human activity? Extreme.
Spreading racist conspiracy theories about immigrants that lead to real and serious threats to people’s lives? Extreme.
Hosting a campaign fundraiser with a violent war criminal who was court-martialed on over a dozen war crimes charges, including murder? Extreme.
With extremists like my opponent, Donald Trump, and JD Vance on the ballot, the stakes in this election are incredibly high – and early voting has already begun in several states across the country. (Here in CA, ballots will be mailed in just two weeks!)
So the time is NOW to do everything in our power to support strong Democratic candidates. Please pitch in whatever you can today, and let’s send a message to the extremists that their values do not reflect ours. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sjj-em]

Thanks for everything.
-Sara

campaign of violence.

body:
With so much on the line in November, If there’s one thing you need to know about me, it’s this: I’ll always put our community first and never stop fighting for us.

| **My story begins right here — in Loudon County — in 1979.**

A few years before I was born, my mother, a native of Bengaluru, India, immigrated to the United States to unite with my father and pursue a career in medicine.

My mom came through Dulles Airport — our family’s “Ellis Island.”
---
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/93426572/500442718/-1771017186?refcode=BLU_EM_ASFG_2024-09-23_1&amount=25&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjQvMS8xMDM4NTgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiYTA4YTgxYjctZjM3OS1lZjExLTk5MWEtNjA0NWJkZWU2NjgxIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=wyTltkNXEVaT4JZpQodcN6uM6EacFHAK7Dsqf4DsBXI=)
**My parents taught me early on how important serving your community is. And at every stage of my life, I’ve felt called to action.**

I attended college in New Orleans — and when Hurricane Katrina hit, I helped organize volunteers on campus to rebuild.

A few years later, I worked with the Center for Wrongful Convictions to free a man wrongfully convicted and imprisoned for 21 years.

On Capitol Hill, as a policy aide, I helped craft the DREAM Act and the Affordable Care Act and build coalitions in support of these critical bills. And I went on to serve as a policy advisor to President Obama in the White House.

**In Richmond, I’ve:**

**✔️ **Taken on Big Pharma, capped prescription drug costs, and fought for medical billing transparency.
**✔️ **Stopped predatory utility rate and toll increases.
**✔️ **Protected abortion rights and fought gun violence.

**With so much on the line in November, If there’s one thing you need to know about me, it’s this: I’ll always put our community first and never stop fighting for us.**

clean_body: With so much on the line in November, If there’s one thing you need to know about me, it’s this: I’ll always put our community first and never stop fighting for us. | My story begins right here — in Loudon County — in 1979. A few years before I was born, my mother, a native of Bengaluru, India, immigrated to the United States to unite with my father and pursue a career in medicine. My mom came through Dulles Airport — our family’s “Ellis Island.” = My parents taught me early on how important serving your community is. And at every stage of my life, I’ve felt called to action. I attended college in New Orleans — and when Hurricane Katrina hit, I helped organize volunteers on campus to rebuild. A few years later, I worked with the Center for Wrongful Convictions to free a man wrongfully convicted and imprisoned for 21 years. On Capitol Hill, as a policy aide, I helped craft the DREAM Act and the Affordable Care Act and build coalitions in support of these critical bills. And I went on to serve as a policy advisor to President Obama in the White House. In Richmond, I’ve: ✔️ Taken on Big Pharma, capped prescription drug costs, and fought for medical billing transparency. ✔️ Stopped predatory utility rate and toll increases. ✔️ Protected abortion rights and fought gun violence. With so much on the line in November, If there’s one thing you need to know about me, it’s this: I’ll always put our community first and never stop fighting for us. = | = | = | = | = | = We’re building a grassroots campaign to keep this district blue, and we need your help. We debated whether or not to send this email.
When it comes to campaigning, our motto has always been to focus on our record, and not give any extreme right-wing opponents any free publicity.
But even if we don’t talk about them much, the reality is we have to take our Republican challengers seriously. Even when our challengers don’t win, the disinformation they spread can discredit our movement if we don’t fight back.
Now, we officially have a challenger for 2024, and she's starting to fundraise.
[We’re now asking if you will contribute $5 today to support Alexandria and ensure we have the resources to win in 43 days? Thank you for being with us,
Team AOC

Republican for Senate

| **ABOUT NELLA**
**New Mexico is Nella Domenici’s home. She was born in Albuquerque and lived for most of her childhood in a home near the intersection of Lomas and Monroe with her seven siblings, and her parents - Pete and Nancy Domenici. Nella began her education at Our Lady of Fatima, where she learned the values she holds today. Nella is a proud third-generation New Mexican, devoted mother of two, step-mom of four, and the wife of a Navy Veteran. Nella’s family’s roots run deep in New Mexico and she and her husband Pat enjoy their family home in New Mexico that they have owned for nearly twenty years.

Like most New Mexicans, Nella Domenici understands the importance of hard work. She waited tables to help pay for her undergraduate degree from Georgetown University, and worked her way through night school at Georgetown Law while holding down a full time job. She then graduated from Harvard Business School as a Baker Scholar, top 5% of the class, while 9 months pregnant.

Nella began her career at the bottom and worked her way up through the complex finance world, eventually serving as CFO for one of the world’s largest, most successful investment firms. In her career, Nella advised, invested in, grew, and led many companies, and served on public company boards. The industries she has worked in are vast and include areas such as health care, AI, food service, lodging, commercial real estate, mortgage lending, and consumer products. These companies have ranged from small family-owned businesses, to rapidly growing venture backed enterprises, to a Fortune 200 company. Several of these have been headquartered in New Mexico. Collectively, the companies Nella has been heavily involved with have employed thousands of Americans.

Like her father and mother, Nella has been a warrior for those who most need an advocate: for women competing in academics or business, for families dealing with mental illness, and for those without access to quality healthcare or education. **

This is why we must abolish the death penalty.

| | | [ ](jillstein2024.com/)
---
Peter,
This is urgent: we can save an innocent man from execution if we act now. Marcellus Williams is set to be executed by the state of Missouri TOMORROW on Tuesday September 24th, even though prosecutors are now saying that he was wrongfully convicted and is actually innocent! Please contact the office of Missouri Governor Mike Parson at 417-373-3400 and tell him to stop the execution of Marcellus Williams before it’s too late. Here’s a short video from Jill with more information on this case and why we need to act now:
