We’ve seen way too many cases like this - which makes it even more outrageous that the Democratic Party has quietly removed opposition to the death penalty from their platform this year. As reported by The Intercept, one of the featured speakers at the DNC was Yusef Salaam, a member of the “Exonerated Five” who Donald Trump famously called to execute after their wrongful imprisonment for a crime they didn’t commit. “Yet in the hours before Salaam spoke at the convention, many Americans were learning for the first time that the DNC had removed its goal of ending capital punishment from its official platform”. Some people call the Democratic Party the “lesser evil”, but when a party that’s actively committing genocide drops its opposition to torture and execution at the same time, we have to ask: is the Democratic-Republican duopoly just one big evil? Thank you for everything you do to save Marcellus Williams and the many other innocent lives in the crosshairs of US empire. In solidarity and gratitude, Team Stein/Ware 2024

|
## Two paths on immigration: division & fear or strengthening America. I choose strength

Immigration is clearly a pillar of Rep. Russell Fry’s campaign, as evidenced by calls on his website for securing the southern border - though he and fellow Republicans in Congress _had_ a bipartisan opportunity to do that last summer. and caved to Donald Trump’s campaigning needs, instead of the needs of the people.
There’s also the predictable capitulation to Trump’s useless vanity project: the wall.Russell’s record on immigration - just this year - is just as capricious.
[**Before we review, can you help my campaign “fire Fry” & help flip the House?**](https://malhyman.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=98998055a4d4c8cdda41af3ea&id=11664a6434&e=5d7e9a146c)
**January:** risking a government shutdown, [Fry voted against](https://malhyman.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=98998055a4d4c8cdda41af3ea&id=c0d5d5acf6&e=5d7e9a146c) a continuing resolution to keep the government functioning, because it did not include draconian immigration gimmicks or spending cuts.
**March:** Fry [sent a letter to the Department of Homeland Security](https://malhyman.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=98998055a4d4c8cdda41af3ea&id=a00e6bf07b&e=5d7e9a146c) (DHS) Secretary Alejandro Mayorkas requesting information regarding reports of migrants being “deposited” in Myrtle Beach; no evidence of such “depositing” was ever discovered. He also called for Mayorkas’ impeachment along with the likes of Marjorie Taylor Greene.
**May:** the [aforementioned bipartisan deal](https://malhyman.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=98998055a4d4c8cdda41af3ea&id=ae7341d7e7&e=5d7e9a146c) \- derailed at the behest of you-know-who ... as weak-spined Senate Republicans fell in line to ignore it at Donald’s self-centered urging. Russell Fry was against the bill all along, so it certainly wouldn’t have gotten his vote in the House.
We’ve seen, in recent weeks, what Republicans have to offer on immigration: the kind of fear-mongering Fry and his fellow MAGA Republicans aim at innocent - and legal - migrants, snaring American citizens in the crossfire, as well. Never ones to let a lack of evidence get in the way of a good story, Trump and JD Vance both spread a vicious and unproven story, dripping in racism and xenophobia. Only the victims weren’t just the legal immigrants. Ask the citizens of Springfield, Ohio what a circus their community’s become - and all over a cat hiding in the basement its owner couldn’t find.
Like Vance and Trump, Russell Fry’s actions here in the 7th Congressional district last spring were nothing short of _fear mongering_ masquerading as strength.
What we’ve come to realize is Republicans like Fry have no interest in fixing our broken immigration system when it’s more fruitful for them to campaign off it and demonize immigrants of color instead. It’s worked to corral a solid “white nationalist” voter base for the GOP since Nixon, so why alter course now, right?
So why the ratcheting up of groundless and wild conspiracy theories about missing-and-eaten pets?
Well, as of August, border encounters with Customs and Border Patrol agents are at their lowest level since 2021. They’re even lower than the number of encounters in 2019 before the pandemic (when you-know-who was President. The Border Patrol credits the Biden administration’s actions from DHS Secretary Mayorkas and Attorney General Merrick Garland.
We’re better than we’ve seen from Trump, Vance, and radical MAGA Republicans like Russell Fry, and it’s well past time to move on from accusing immigrants of causing crime, stealing jobs and bringing fentanyl into the country. Oh, and definitely time to stop insisting they’re eating pets.
_None of that is true!_
Instead, it’s time to do what Americans used to do best: tackle heady problems with solutions that _strengthen_ America:

* A viable pathway to citizenship for those who have been here for years and decades, and who have made important contributions to their communities ... that _strengthens_ America.

* Developing immigration policies that are fair and will also grow the American economy ... that _strengthens_ America.

* Understanding why people are coming to the US - and addressing “root causation” of such migration ... that _strengthens_ America: South America, Central America and the United States of America.

Ronald Reagan actually wanted to work with Mexico to make the border "something other than the location for a fence." After all, a border is just a line on a map. It’s time we Americans drew a line ourselves and put an end to white nationalist isolationism. That will strengthen America.
Immigration is a challenge for all industrialized countries. Choosing to be grown-ups, addressing our challenge is the long overlooked path for a nation of thoughtful leaders. Donald Trump, JD Vance, Marjorie Taylor Greene and Russell Fry ... clearly not thoughtful, and certainly not leaders.
MAGA Republicans choose to stoke division & fear. When I’m in Congress, I’ll choose strengthening America - every time.

Amendment 3 threatens the health and safety of all kids in Florida. Help me oppose it.| | | [](http://links.freedom.rondesantis.com/u/click?_t=bc9491309104472aae4991b59e968283&_m=25478216dba94fa5b0f97c1e53446ef5&_e=Mh-oNuwL05wmS0Xly8aXn7pVvJ6B9mE1gGOHNE-ma1yWqdAQVW1ieBUeOrom_asyN3J70Ib7ydSOFofKez-IIxujHUEXXwjyv9G3DZ80kmDDzG36jMo_QquGUJbAi5sx541ZJcMjwHyGhXB6KLMgmDV30-IEoUMYcwk5dbQCacd4Fkdk6-y5vJBEvWRHs_BNb5aqLNBb_uc86vtsMIREUXpWwEa8-AU766ROElbacesfkmoBeLLnymulLRQlV6f9s-EECy65otnwBMIrcujkV0kW1Il3W8NwGx5z-OKeFHyFvn32q921qZepjwlTNamQTK1UG1D8AcexgvzkfG632bb-83HY0K3Td_ZY8rAFUgh-5zbnpymNlEgLOyXXGMnZOvXJTOPaAkScV3Ny5VhGHw%3D%3D)
---
Dear Fellow Floridians, I’m writing to you today to sound the alarm on Amendment 3, a radical marijuana legalization ballot measure that puts Florida kids at risk. This amendment would not just legalize recreational marijuana across our state. It’s so much worse than that. **Amendment 3 would override local rules protecting our public spaces, normalizing open marijuana use around our children.**
---
[**PROTECT OUR CHILDREN: DONATE HERE**](http://links.freedom.rondesantis.com/u/click?_t=bc9491309104472aae4991b59e968283&_m=25478216dba94fa5b0f97c1e53446ef5&_e=Mh-oNuwL05wmS0Xly8aXn7pVvJ6B9mE1gGOHNE-ma1yWqdAQVW1ieBUeOrom_asyN3J70Ib7ydSOFofKez-IIxujHUEXXwjyv9G3DZ80kmDDzG36jMo_QquGUJbAi5sx541ZJcMjwHyGhXB6KLMgmDV30-IEoUMYcwk5dbQCacd4Fkdk6-y5vJBEvWRHs_BNb5aqLNBb_uc86vtsMIREUXpWwEa8-AU766ROElbacesfkmoBeLLnymulLRQlV6f9s5V11N13TwNwnNAXkBKNiR3F8B-MIcLR3ZRDvRcDDyMQGVR4onAeWYHgk428XAQdeAYYjoyYrFNeBIXRKhc5dPQn1IelSWZjffFDUsl2n-T8pVQVekgjuZBj9Cb-xRZ8c-CoyQNrJE95fQw-CCUIJQ%3D%3D)
---
With no restrictions on where marijuana can be consumed, its presence would become commonplace in our parks, beaches, and even near schools. Our kids would be exposed to it everywhere they went. And so much marijuana is now packaged as kid-appealing gummies that it’s even more insidious. If you think this won't lead to increased accidental exposure among our children, it's important to note that it's already happening. Across the nation, there have been distressing incidents where children have mistakenly ingested marijuana - even here in Florida... Just this March, in Port St. Lucie, ten students at Oak Hammock K-8 were hospitalized after consuming THC-infused gummies given to them during school, mistaking them for regular candy.
---
[](http://links.freedom.rondesantis.com/u/click?_t=bc9491309104472aae4991b59e968283&_m=25478216dba94fa5b0f97c1e53446ef5&_e=Mh-oNuwL05wmS0Xly8aXn7pVvJ6B9mE1gGOHNE-ma1yWqdAQVW1ieBUeOrom_asyN3J70Ib7ydSOFofKez-IIxujHUEXXwjyv9G3DZ80kmDDzG36jMo_QquGUJbAi5sx541ZJcMjwHyGhXB6KLMgmDV30-IEoUMYcwk5dbQCacd4Fkdk6-y5vJBEvWRHs_BNb5aqLNBb_uc86vtsMIREUXpWwEa8-AU766ROElbacesfkmoBeLLnymulLRQlV6f9H5bbZ4jDtFBwyukivCmiSBE0Fyrf7ylV_ccihmMH1n_F_JNwaF8O56_5SpKaP3UijKqmIJ0c9y4Tt9RWmzfJT7t25ZvVn889fdNvnPZmFTwQpe9WaJK_dvM4N0lcLFzcNzhX5tP0NdDayjblOb_aDg%3D%3D)
---
[**PROTECT OUR KIDS: OPPOSE AMENDMENT 3**](http://links.freedom.rondesantis.com/u/click?_t=bc9491309104472aae4991b59e968283&_m=25478216dba94fa5b0f97c1e53446ef5&_e=Mh-oNuwL05wmS0Xly8aXn7pVvJ6B9mE1gGOHNE-ma1yWqdAQVW1ieBUeOrom_asyN3J70Ib7ydSOFofKez-IIxujHUEXXwjyv9G3DZ80kmDDzG36jMo_QquGUJbAi5sx541ZJcMjwHyGhXB6KLMgmDV30-IEoUMYcwk5dbQCacd4Fkdk6-y5vJBEvWRHs_BNb5aqLNBb_uc86vtsMIREUXpWwEa8-AU766ROElbacesfkmoBeLLnymulLRQlV6f9_IK_3g9tFvozpuzPgG4BqMGq5H8X9FUqeU6lx1_yS-NqluQ3Dfv3sJP3gC-eGiTYCQpJ8OKkx4Q1hqzpXfb1zgBmEsP-SB4rxFR3GR-87dm2n9apgn683ljrRlgE2BZYHvjpj51qAqT6aNp-_cHUcA%3D%3D)
---
These cases are not isolated. They are part of a troubling rise in pediatric admissions related to marijuana - incidents that would certainly increase with the passage of Amendment 3. **The choice is ours: Do we want Florida to be a state where kids are safe to play, or where drug users are encouraged to get high? ** I know my answer. That’s why I’m putting my full support behind the **Vote No On 3****** campaign. We believe in safeguarding our children and maintaining a family-friendly Florida. If you too support a safe Florida, then I encourage you to donate to their efforts here. Your donation can help us educate voters about the dangers of Amendment 3 and mobilize the necessary resources to protect our children.
---
[**DONATE HERE**](http://links.freedom.rondesantis.com/u/click?_t=bc9491309104472aae4991b59e968283&_m=25478216dba94fa5b0f97c1e53446ef5&_e=Mh-oNuwL05wmS0Xly8aXn7pVvJ6B9mE1gGOHNE-ma1yWqdAQVW1ieBUeOrom_asyN3J70Ib7ydSOFofKez-IIxujHUEXXwjyv9G3DZ80kmDDzG36jMo_QquGUJbAi5sx541ZJcMjwHyGhXB6KLMgmDV30-IEoUMYcwk5dbQCacd4Fkdk6-y5vJBEvWRHs_BNb5aqLNBb_uc86vtsMIREUXpWwEa8-AU766ROElbacesfkmoBeLLnymulLRQlV6f9HTZ1TFgH1UF9x1-za8exKb5Aj_dvc9vFGzukBYyJCQplWKVu--3PTp9slY-MWuLN3HtCmlv0mtzYi1npEtdPc_AG2dIBFEHqZB0f3rZgSTM0cy8MOh232CSu2N7ehhMKoQG4_YZ_r1HxEX30ms1wHw%3D%3D)

This is Alan Cohn from Term Limit the Court, the national campaign working with members of Congress like Hakeem Jeffries, Adam Schiff, and Sheldon Whitehouse to adopt 18-year term limits on SCOTUS that would retire Clarence Thomas, Samuel Alito, and Chief Justice John Roberts. We started with eight co-sponsors in the House a year ago and now have 55 co-sponsors in the House and 9 in the Senate. Vice President Kamala Harris just announced she’ll push for SCOTUS term limits, and Chuck Schumer says it will be “a top priority” if we keep the Senate. We’re backing candidates for the Senate and House pledging to support the TERM Act, but WE NEED YOUR HELP! = The MAGA majority has already robbed women of their right to control their own bodies AND created immunity for Donald Trump for his January 6th crimes. The MAGA majority isn’t even pretending to abide by its motto, “Equal justice on the law.” We can take the politics out of the court by ending lifetime appointments. = Alan Cohn Term Limit the Court The American people have lost confidence in the Supreme Court after a series of rulings that strike at the core of our freedoms. There are term limits for a President. Term limits for many governors and state legislators. And the time has come for term limits for members of the Supreme Court. Now, we're counting on your help to provide the resources we need to work directly with members of Congress and their staff to support the introduction of term-limit legislation and raise awareness about this legislative solution to the growing distrust in the Supreme Court. =** = SPONSORED BY TERM LIMITS YES, INC. 7903 HAMPTON LAKE DR. TAMPA, FL 33647 Term Limits Yes, Inc. 7903 Hampton Lake Dr. Tampa, FL 33647 United States

At 23 years old and in charge of roughly 350 Americans, Afghans, and expatriates, and responsible for nearly $100 million worth of infrastructure and equipment, it was an experience that shaped him for the rest of his life and led him to where he is today.

When Pat returned to the United States, he volunteered and was selected for the Special Forces, and moved to North Carolina to complete Special Forces training. **After becoming a Green Beret, he returned to Afghanistan and led his Special Forces unit.** It became clear to Pat that the United States had lost the political will to win, and we had a true crisis of leadership brewing in our country.

They need Arizona to retake the White House. They need Arizona to control the U.S. Senate. And right now, they’ve got a real chance at both.
#

Peter, we send a lot of emails. We don’t expect you to chip in every time we ask. But we do need you to take that step and chip in from time to time, when you can.
And today, we really need you to chip in. Please, let us explain why:

**_NOW:_** The latest New York Times/Siena poll has Trump up by FOUR POINTS in Arizona, and Ruben’s race tightening. This is a five alarm fire.
It would be one thing if this was some two-bit polling outfit, but it’s not. The Times/Siena poll is one of the best out there. And if Trump’s leading by that much he’s almost certain to bring Kari Lake with him — just like he said he would.
They need Arizona to retake the White House. They need Arizona to control the U.S. Senate. And right now, they’ve got a real chance at both.

| Hello, I hope that your weekend was great.

On Thursday I keynoted the Independent National Convention in Denver. It was a blast being among so many people who have figured out that the two-party system could use an upgrade.

Of course the main question on everyone’s mind right now is who is going to win in November and become the next President. I had a grim sense of Trump’s return for months. With Kamala Harris’s rise, I now see it as neck-and-neck. Either candidate could win. I hope it’s Kamala.

There are 7 states that are being contested by both candidates. They’re all important of course, but which of them is the most pivotal? Pennsylvania. Whoever wins Pennsylvania likely wins the election.

Pennsylvania is just about as down the middle as it gets; even its state legislature is 50-50. And who wins Pennsylvania could come down to a little-known candidate named Eric Settle.

Who is Eric Settle you ask? [Eric Settle](https://yangspeaks.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7448319cdb745ea2fd1b1b8a8&id=8a81214b56&e=0f227c2ae3) is an Independent candidate for Attorney General running in Pennsylvania as a Forwardist.

Eric and I met months ago. “I was a Tom Ridge Republican, the sort of thing that doesn’t really exist in Pennsylvania anymore.” Indeed, Eric was a deputy general counsel for Governor Ridge and worked on Governor Shapiro’s Health and Human Services transition team before working as senior counsel for a healthcare company. “When I was in the governor’s office, I had 150 lawyers that reported to me.” Eric met up with me and a bunch of other Forwardists in Philadelphia and began to see that his state still needs him.

“Wouldn’t it be amazing if the Attorney General – the one who is supposed to administer the laws on behalf of the state – didn’t have a partisan jersey on? That’s the pitch I’m making to Pennsylvanians. AGs are intended to be law enforcement, officials who are trying to call it the way they see it. The parties have become too polarized – it’s too dangerous to compromise. A handful of elected officials who are free to make the right call for PA can become a fulcrum of change. My case to Pennsylvanians is that an independent attorney general is worth their vote.”

It’s a good pitch and Eric Settle is an outstanding candidate.

Why could Eric’s campaign be so important? There were about 6.9 million votes cast in Pennsylvania in 2020 and the gap between Biden and Trump was only 80,000 votes. It may be even closer this time. Let’s say that 10,000 to 20,000 voters vote for [Eric Settle](https://yangspeaks.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7448319cdb745ea2fd1b1b8a8&id=ae6de244fd&e=0f227c2ae3) or State Treasurer Candidate [Chris Foster](https://yangspeaks.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7448319cdb745ea2fd1b1b8a8&id=be229d19c6&e=0f227c2ae3), also running as a Forwardist. These may be people discouraged with both major parties who enjoy the idea of an impartial referee.

Could people voting for [Eric](https://yangspeaks.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7448319cdb745ea2fd1b1b8a8&id=7eac9b1903&e=0f227c2ae3) or [Chris](https://yangspeaks.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7448319cdb745ea2fd1b1b8a8&id=3c1125cd71&e=0f227c2ae3) be the difference-makers as to who wins Pennsylvania and the White House? The math says yes. The math also says that money sent to Eric Settle to make his pitch is going to be much higher impact than money sent to either major party, as they will already be spending gobs of money in the Keystone State.

I’ve donated to Eric Settle’s [campaign](https://yangspeaks.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7448319cdb745ea2fd1b1b8a8&id=20a23417d3&e=0f227c2ae3) and I hope you consider doing so as well. His campaign could be crucial to the whole election. “Don’t settle for less.” The sensible independents of Pennsylvania showing up to the polls could make all the difference. You can donate to Eric's campaign [here](https://yangspeaks.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7448319cdb745ea2fd1b1b8a8&id=f5fe8f9863&e=0f227c2ae3) and spread the word to your friends in Pennsylvania.

To see Forward Party’s endorsed candidates around the country click [here](https://yangspeaks.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7448319cdb745ea2fd1b1b8a8&id=825e9ae496&e=0f227c2ae3) – they could use your support!

name: Rev. Darrius Butler
subject: the biggest difference
body:
Just weeks ago I was removed from the voter rolls for the second time in the past five years. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/93430880/500457801/-330727681?refcode=logo&amount=10&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNjEvMS8xMTI0OTciLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiZDM4NWZiY2YtMDQ3YS1lZjExLTk5MWEtNjA0NWJkZWU2NjgxIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=BNcpJJrTWKKGJrIxxo-6rfy4N5dkHf5-MXmBboIsej8=)
---

Friend,

I, like tens of thousands of Georgians, have had to **fight to keep my right to vote.**

Just weeks ago I was removed from the voter rolls for the _second_ time in the past five years.

It’s no secret that people and places historically oppressed are often subject to attacks on voting rights, and Georgia is no different.

Emboldened by Republican-passed election laws here in Georgia, just 6 right-wing activists have challenged the registration of _89,000 voters_ , just like you and me.

_If they’re so bold_ to challenge my registration as I’m actively running for Congress, we can only imagine how many Georgians will face disenfranchisement this November.

**We saw this playbook in 2020 when Donald Trump tried to steal the election — focused right here in Georgia — while my opponent, Congressman Austin Scott supported him.**

They only win when Georgians can’t make themselves heard, but the difference between me and Austin Scott on this issue is: **I want him to vote. I want everyone to vote and I want that vote to be honored. Because I believe in Democracy, and the will of the people even when they don’t agree with me.**

The Georgia GOP used their power to restrict voting because they know their platform serves a shrinking minority of this country and they need to rig the game to win. **_They can only hold office through fear and suppression, and they’ll continue to strip our rights away as long as they do._**

Our right to choose is on the ballot.
Our right to speak is on the ballot.
Our right to real representation is on the ballot.

Which means our right to vote _needs_ to be used this election — **not because we fear, because we fight.**

More soon,
Reverend Butler
